Here's what our experts say.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:20:16 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1020/r1733193_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>How the Knicks celebrated their long-awaited championship in the offseason</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50221526/how-new-york-knicks-celebrated-championship-offseason</link><description>From Jalen Brunson's SNL appearance to KAT's wedding, it all began with one event that turned into a domino effect: a Knicks title.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:44:34 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1020/r1733188_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>LeBron James' most notable Madison Square Garden appearances</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/39431648/lebron-james-madison-square-garden-best-performances</link><description>Here are some of LeBron James' memorable performances at the world's most famous arena throughout the years as he faces the Knicks on Tuesday.</description><pubDate>Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:43:07 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2024/0131/r1285187_608x342_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
